summary: Thirteen official documents that could not be opened directly were read from copies supplied to the project, and eleven records were updated and independently reviewed. No record changed stage. Main corrections: the 2026 National Defense Strategy places homeland defense first and China second and does not mention Taiwan, while committing to a denial defense along the First Island Chain and to allies taking primary responsibility for conventional defense in Europe and Korea (c04-08 stays in progress as a partial match); the FCC adopted an order on 2026-08-06 repealing the 39 percent national television ownership cap, with no effective date shown (c28-06); Public Law 119-60 raises the Junior ROTC unit range to 3,600 to 4,200 from 2027-10-01 and contains no ASVAB mandate (c04-14); enacted FY2026 humanitarian funding is 5.50 billion dollars, 25.8 percent below FY2025 (c09-05). Documents the reviewer could not open itself are marked as such on each record. Six requested documents remain unread by any route and are listed in the leads file.
title: Official documents read for eleven records
